title: StockSmart Annual Service Level Review — Tier Moves at the Go-Live Anniversary
content:
Account management note for the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program.

**Rule.** At each anniversary of go-live the program's trailing 12 month program spend and bin count are compared with its tier's entry gate; a program meeting a higher tier's gate may move up at the customer's request, and a program below its own tier's gate moves down to the highest tier whose gate it meets, never below StockSmart Self-Scan. A tier change takes effect on the first day of the next calendar month and does not restart the minimum term.

### Outcomes at the anniversary

| Program's trailing 12 month figures | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Meet a higher tier's gate | may move up, at the customer's request |
| Meet the program's own tier's gate and no higher | stays at its tier |
| Below the program's own tier's gate | moves down to the highest tier whose gate it meets, never below StockSmart Self-Scan |

### Timing

A change decided at the anniversary takes effect on the first day of the next calendar month. The minimum term keeps running from the original go-live date.

**Hypothetical.** A program whose go-live anniversary falls on 12 June moves tier with effect from 1 July; its minimum term is not restarted.

**Basis question — can the review move a program up without the customer asking?** No. A move up happens at the customer's request; a move down follows from the figures.
